in_marathi.name: Midhun
in_marathi.long_meaning: Midhun हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Derived from the Sanskrit word 'Mithuna', meaning 'Sun'. In Hindu mythology, Mithuna is the name of the zodiac sign Taurus and one of the Navagrahas (nine celestial beings). The name is believed to bring prosperity, wealth, and success.

In Hindu mythology, Mithuna is the name of the zodiac sign Taurus and one of the Navagrahas (nine celestial beings). The name is believed to bring prosperity, wealth, and success.
